_doc: Patient information that reputable UK organisations publish in OTHER LANGUAGES, one row per page, read from each organisation's own translated-information hub (fetched on 'built'). The title is the organisation's own link text; the language is what its page says (lang_label verbatim, lang = code). format: html pages can be translated by a phone; pdf cannot. status/checked come from the verify pass. medrics translates nothing and endorses nothing; every row is a public page at its URL. Decision record, 2026-09-22 (specs/leaflets.md G-picker-3).
